snippet.title: Detective of the Dead - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you solve your own murder in the afterlife?

Detective of the Dead is a narrative adventure with RPG and cozy cooking elements set in the colorful Mexican afterworld.

Cook tacos for suspects by day, gather clues, and investigate supernatural mysteries by night alongside your magical dog Xolo. Time is running out before Día de los Muertos… and more lives are at stake.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084040/Detective_of_the_Dead/


🌮 About the Game

🕵️ A Deadly Mystery
• Play as a dead detective solving your own murder
• Uncover a conspiracy that threatens Día de los Muertos

🌮 Cook to Get Clues
• Run a cozy taco stand during the day
• The better you cook, the more secrets your customers reveal

🌙 Investigate at Night
• Follow clues, solve puzzles, and track suspects
• Switch between Alejandro and your magic dog Xolo

🐕 Dual Gameplay
• Each character has unique abilities
• Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden paths

🌎 A Vibrant Afterlife
• Semi-open 3D world inspired by Mexican culture
• Handcrafted characters with unique stories and side quests

🎮 Game Features
• 7 to 10 hours of gameplay with multiple endings
• Cozy cooking + detective gameplay loop
• Authentic mini-games and cultural elements
• Original soundtrack inspired by regional Mexican music

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains light themes related to death presented in a comic and non-graphic way.
